entities.name: Octavian's military campaigns in Illyricum
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Octavian's military campaigns in Illyricum constitute the first attempt by the future emperor Augustus, then known as Octavian, to occupy the northern Illyrian region. This conflict came shortly after achieving a definitive victory over Sextus Pompey in Roman Sicily and before the decisive clash with his fellow triumvir, Mark Antony, in Roman Greece and Ptolemaic Egypt. Octavian was wounded in battle during the first conflict. However, the triumph for his victories was delayed and celebrated only after the defeat of Mark Antony and Cleopatra.
